title: ML Tool for Cardiac Health Assessment with ECG
description: Machine learning model to analyze ECG signals and estimate the cardiac health of athletes.
longDescription: I developed a software tool that integrates ECG signal processing and machine learning models to evaluate cardiac health indicators in athletes. I built the dataset from Kaggle and Physionet, processed signals, and migrated data to train a neural network in MATLAB. I also participated in model integration with a graphical interface using AppDesigner, resolving backend and frontend issues.

title: Mango Leaf Disease Detection (Computer Vision)
description: Computer vision system in MATLAB to detect infected areas in mango leaves.
longDescription: I developed a desktop image processing application to segment mango leaves and identify infected zones. I implemented filters, basic kernels, and segmentation across different color spaces (RGB, HSV, YCbCr) to improve contour and region detection.
highlights: Image segmentation across multiple color spaces

title: Physician Data Acquisition
description: Large-scale data extraction and cleaning of physician records from a website.
longDescription: I developed scraping scripts to extract information such as name, address, and consultation cost from multiple pages. I implemented cleaning, validation, and consolidation processes, delivering the final data in Excel format for further analysis.

title: Notary Data Acquisition
description: Scraping system to extract over 10,000 notary records and generate structured datasets.
longDescription: I built a data acquisition pipeline using Selenium, BeautifulSoup, and Requests to extract contact information at scale. I processed and structured the data with Pandas and NumPy, delivering the final output as CSV files ready for analysis and commercial use.

title: Python Web Development (Réflex)
description: Frontend and UI/UX for a conference website using Réflex.
longDescription: I participated in UI/UX design and developed frontend sections using Réflex (Python framework), integrating HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Tailwind. Focus on responsive design and user experience.

title: Fullstack Web Development
description: Design, development, and deployment of a fullstack website for a client.
longDescription: I gathered requirements, designed mockups in Framer, and developed the complete frontend using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript. I implemented styles with Tailwind CSS, integrated a functional contact form, optimized basic SEO, and deployed via FileZilla and Hostinger. I also generated graphic assets using AI and Canva.
highlights: Image creation with Canva and AI

title: Image Classification Model with Deep Learning
description: Image classification using convolutional neural networks (CNN) with TensorFlow and Keras.
longDescription: I assisted in the development of a deep learning model to classify images into different categories. I used TensorFlow and Keras to build and train a convolutional neural network (CNN), applying data augmentation and optimization techniques to improve model accuracy.

title: This Portfolio Website
description: Layout, structure, and development of my personal portfolio website.
longDescription: I designed and developed my portfolio website using Next.js and React for the frontend, implementing styles with Tailwind CSS. I organized the project structure, integrated reusable components, and optimized performance for a better user experience.
This project allowed me to apply good programming practices and continue improving my skills in web and software development.
highlights: Version control with Git and GitHub
